findings.observation: Temporal adds rear/side support; ghost layers and incomplete surfaces remain. Higher observed-surface recall does not prove a complete clean object.
High LiDAR recall in both controls coexists with thin/incomplete surfaces in canonical directions.
Sparse selected points; deleting those points does not visually remove the complete apparent car. Depth localization and instance binding remain unresolved.
Canonical views contain sign/trailer fragments and ground-like stripes. No pixel instance GT to quantify contamination.
Mostly one-sided observed geometry; movement/deletion exposes unfilled regions.

limits: 3x3 point splat itself introduces sampling holes; sky/depth>80m is intentionally absent.
GT projected box selection does not certify visible pixels; occluded examples cannot define a visible-object failure rate.
